name: Shanghai Kelai Mechatronics Engineering Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Kelai Mechatronics Engineering Co.,Ltd. engages in the intelligent equipment and auto parts business in China and internationally. It is involved in the research, testing, and manufacturing of automotive electronic products and interior products, such as electric drive, electronic control, power semiconductor modules, and intelligent driver assistance systems for new energy vehicles; and manufacturing equipment for medical packaging materials and semiconductor tapes, as well as provides assembly, testing, and logistics services.
